incarnation: Nexus de Convergence — Oryn Xile, canon original du projet2026, atlas courant4×4 et dossier de Route X

limitations: Original project generated atlas retained as internal visual canon, not an independent franchise reference.
No separate orthographic blade model or facial portrait; small details remain resolution-limited.

visualLocks.face: Warm olive/tan skin, dark eyes, short tousled black hair with magenta-red front forelock, angular face and light stubble; no white forelock or right-cheek scar borrowed from Marrow.
visualLocks.anatomy: Human, two arms/two legs and ordinary hands; no precise age established.
visualLocks.costume: Long dark charcoal/plum smith coat/tabard/apron with red-coral outlined diamonds, dark shoulder guards, ivory forearm wraps, dark wrist/fingerless gloves, leather tool belt, dark trousers and strapped dark boots.
visualLocks.equipment: Broad flat dark threshold greatsword, one red-coral luminous cutting edge, nested diamond engravings, angular geometric brass/steel guard, long dark wrapped grip and round small pommel. Small tools at waist belong to the workshop profession.
visualLocks.palette: Primary #241f2d and secondary #e04f64, blade #ff8798; dark/plum cloth, coral marks and restrained brass/ivory.
visualLocks.forbiddenMixes: No Nadir reel/drone/pistol, Anchor gauntlet, Marrow white forelock/scar/crystal blade, medical cross or wizard hat; no fixed handedness inferred from gameplay category.

loreEvidence.role: Route X threshold blade artisan and temporary name-bearer in ZERO.
loreEvidence.doctrine: Return speech to each witness rather than speak on their behalf; recut suppressed signatures and protect separate testimonies.

limitations: Atlas interne généré retenu par le projet = autorité visuelle de cette création originale, pas une source de licence externe.
Résolution du visage, outils et petites gravures de la lame limitée par le pixelart source; aucune certification parfaite1:1.
Âge chiffré non établi; toutes les scènes restent familiales et non romantiques.
La mèche magenta distingue Oryn de la mèche blanche et cicatrice de Marrow; ne pas transférer ces marques.
